case_number: I.A. No. 56308 of 2023 in Writ Petition (C) No. 191 of 2022
summary: The Union of India applied for directions to transfer Rs. 5,000 crores from the unutilized 'Sahara-SEBI Refund Account' to the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies for disbursement to genuine depositors of the Sahara Group of Cooperative Societies. The Court found the request reasonable and in the public interest, noting that part of the corpus in the refund account originated from depositors' funds. The order mandates transparent, verified disbursement under judicial supervision with time-bound implementation.
final_judgment: Application allowed; Rs. 5,000 crores to be transferred and disbursed to genuine depositors within nine months under supervision of Former Judge Justice R. Subhash Reddy and Amicus Curiae Shri Gaurav Agarwal; balance to be returned to the Sahara-SEBI Refund Account.
